portMethod: byte-identical frozen copy, original relative import specifiers unchanged (per docs/migration/parity-test-porting.md §3), no candidate-binding seam created because no candidate interface exists anywhere in the rewrite

binding.seam: none created — no genuine interface exists to bind to; AGENTS.md and sol-test-wave.md prohibit fake adapters

cases.title: advances a live Claude chain head and its proof
obligations: resumed link with matching leafUuid becomes the new chain head (providerHandleChain.at(-1)?.handle toMatchObject leafUuid: 'leaf-2')
a live lease's provenHandleLinkId advances to the new head link id (lease.provenHandleLinkId toBe 'link-2')

cases.title: records a leaf during proof without granting ownership
obligations: a lease in new-owner-proving/reserved state still appends the resumed link as chain head (providerHandleChain.at(-1)?.handle toMatchObject leafUuid: 'leaf-2')

that same lease's claimStatus stays 'reserved' and provenHandleLinkId stays null — proof of a handle must not itself grant ownership (lease toMatchObject { claimStatus: 'reserved', provenHandleLinkId: null })
